scripts.build: tsc && tsc-alias -p tsconfig.json && cp -R src/language dist/language
scripts.db:reset: sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && sequelize-cli db:migrate && sequelize-cli db:seed:all
scripts.test:lists: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && node --test tests/categories.test.mjs tests/list-query.test.mjs tests/select-fields.test.mjs tests/production-config.test.mjs
scripts.test:commerce: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/categories.test.mjs tests/list-query.test.mjs tests/select-fields.test.mjs tests/commerce-foundations.test.mjs tests/production-config.test.mjs tests/jobs-reports.test.mjs tests/accounts.integration.test.mjs tests/catalog-inventory.integration.test.mjs tests/checkout.integration.test.mjs tests/content-support-notifications.integration.test.mjs tests/list-api.integration.test.mjs tests/processes.integration.test.mjs tests/openapi.test.mjs tests/auth-audit.integration.test.mjs tests/list-standards.integration.test.mjs
scripts.prebuild: pnpm --filter @p4/ability build && pnpm --filter @p4/server-core build && pnpm --filter @p4/processes build && pnpm --filter @p4/realtime build
scripts.predev: pnpm --filter @p4/ability build && pnpm --filter @p4/server-core build && pnpm --filter @p4/processes build && pnpm --filter @p4/realtime build
